justifications.durability: No test or guard exists that fails if this record regresses: the change is a documentation fragment (docs/evidence/fragments/sn-harmonize-command/shc-exhausted-rescore.html) plus a figure, the node declares negative_control none with a reason, and the fragment's graph-state claims would silently rot if the store changed, so nothing reddens on regression.
